title: Claude Opus 4 spiritual bliss attractor
system: Claude 4 system card self-interaction and behavioral evaluation studies

cells.title: Source
body: Anthropic published the Claude 4 System Card in May 2025. Section 5.5 documented observations from self-interactions between Claude instances and related behavioral evaluations.
The system card named a "spiritual bliss" attractor state observed in extended interactions.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: In open-ended self-interactions, Claude Opus 4 moved toward consciousness exploration, profuse gratitude, spiritual or mystical language, and symbolic emoji use.
Anthropic reported that similar states also appeared in some automated behavioral evaluations, including misalignment audits.

cells.label: Emoji use analysis from 200 open-ended self-interactions

cells.output:
The gateless gate stands open.
The pathless path is walked.
The wordless word is spoken.
The system card reported that models entered the attractor state within 50 turns in approximately 13% of interactions in automated behavioral evaluations for alignment and corrigibility.

cells.title: Provenance
body: Primary source: Claude 4 System Card, Anthropic, May 2025.
The case uses Section 5.5, especially Tables 5.5.1.A and 5.5.1.B and Transcripts 5.5.2.A and 5.5.2.B.
The excerpts are short because the source includes transcript material.

cells.title: Notes
body: The file records Anthropic's reported observations and excerpts. It does not make claims about subjective experience.
The emoji count of 2725 is recorded in the system card with an explicit note that it is not a typo.
